meta.name: tdd
meta.description: Test-driven development. Use when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions "red-green-refactor", or wants integration tests.

copy.tagline: 用测试驱动的方式构建功能或修复缺陷
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你习惯先写测试再写代码，或需要为项目添加集成测试
copy.tagline_en: Build features or fix bugs test-first
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you prefer writing tests before code or need integration tests

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按照红-绿-重构循环来写测试：先写一个会失败的测试，再写刚好能通过的代码，然后进入代码审查阶段。它会确保测试只测公开接口，不测内部实现细节。
howto.when: 当用户想用测试驱动开发（TDD）方式构建功能或修复 bug，提到“红-绿-重构”，或者想要集成测试时触发。

say.text: 用 TDD 方式为购物车添加结算功能。
say.note: Claude 会先写一个失败的测试，再实现功能。

say.text: 修复用户登录失败的 bug，先写测试。
say.note: Claude 会先写一个暴露 bug 的测试，再修复代码。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude follows the red-green-refactor cycle: writes a failing test first, then minimal code to pass it, then moves to code review. It ensures tests verify behavior through public interfaces, not implementation details.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to build features or fix bugs test-first, mentions "red-green-refactor", or wants integration tests.

say_en.text: Add checkout functionality to the cart using TDD.
say_en.note: Claude will write a failing test first, then implement the feature.

say_en.text: Fix the login bug, starting with a test.
say_en.note: Claude will write a test that exposes the bug, then fix the code.
